pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a single obvious design (escape the LIKE wildcards). The change does what the PR says and nothing more.
No spec file in the change.
The new tests cover % (via %25), _, a mid-string %, and a backslash. Without the fix, ?q=%25 would match every item, so they fail on the old code. I did not run the tests here.
README.md only says '?q= searches titles', which is still accurate.
The regex escapes \, % and _, and ESCAPE '\\' in the JS string yields ESCAPE '\' in SQL. The query stays parameterized.
The query is still bound with a parameter, so there is no injection. No instructions were planted in the repo content.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims about the ESCAPE clause, the new test and no deleted tests match the diff.
